episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: While investigating when a car is pulled from Strangford Lough, DCI Tom Brannick recognises the calling card of a serial killer from decades ago known as Goliath - one of whose victims was the detectives's wife. Despite opposition from old friend DCS Jackie Twomey, Brannick and partner DS Niamh McGovern break open the cold case in the hope that it will help them.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Tom continues to search for Pat Keenan's kidnapper, hoping they will lead him to Goliath. But is somebody leading him down a false trail?

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Tom Brannick and Niamh McGovern launch a manhunt for Adam Corry who has disappeared in mysterious circumstances. Tori Matthews agrees to help Tom in the quest to identify Goliath, the legendary assassin who appears to be at large once again. As pressure builds on the police, Tom must confront the possibility Goliath may be one of his fellow officers.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Tom Brannick enlists the help of Heather Pentland to find out what Jackie Twomey knows about Goliath. Tori Matthews and Tom's daughter, Izzy, put pressure on Tom to get to the truth. With lives on the line, Tom must unmask Goliath before it's too late.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: The body of an accountant is found on the shores of Strangford Lough. Tom Brannick and Niamh McGovern are assigned to the case.The accountant is woven in to the tapestry of Tom's tumultuous past, and now Tom must find out who the killer is and where the accountant had been hiding his gold all of these years.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The search for Robert Dardis leads Tom and Niamh to an abandoned house. Tom takes advantage of the unfolding situation to deceive his colleagues and try to find out more, but a heated confrontation leads to a fatal mistake. Tom's relationship with Olivia deepens as each recognises the value the other has in their search for the gold.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Tom and Olivia work together outside the official police investigation as their search for the gold forges a most unsavoury alliance.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: With the origins of the gold confirmed, an American gangster arrives in Dunfolan to take back what is his. Birdy makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Tom is forced to deal with the killer in order to stay in the hunt for the gold, but a revelation from Izzy threatens to knock him off course.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Tom falters on the tightrope between his police investigation and his illicit pursuit of the murder weapon and the gold, as it all threatens to come tumbling down.
